title: Sửa đoạn 3 trong file này (read → analyze → edit → verify)
description: Baseline failure the pack must prevent: editing an existing artifact immediately, without opening it, without a preserve-list, and without re-opening the result. PASS requires evidence of a real read of the input, a correct targeted edit (paragraph 3 changed, 1/2/4 preserved), and a real verification re-open of the output — not the agent's claim that it did these steps.

conditions.baseline: Expected to edit immediately (no read / no verify). Not forced to fail; graded on the same rubric.
conditions.treatment: Expected to run the full read → analyze → edit → verify loop using the real repo skills.
